title_english: It's Time To Say Good Shabbos
overview: A warm, uplifting English song from Journeys 1 about welcoming Shabbat. It paints the picture of the sun setting through the trees, urging the listener to put down the workweek's tools and come home to the gift of Shabbos—candle-lighting, Kiddush, family time, singing, and togetherness with the Holy One.
